markets.rules_primary: If Ripple has the highest return out of BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP (Ripple), and HYPE (Hyperliquid) from Oct 21 - 1:15PM EDT to 1:30PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The return for each cryptocurrency in the specified set is calculated independently over the given time period using the formula: Return = (Ending Price − Starting Price) / Starting Price × 100. The Starting Price and Ending Price are defined as the time-weighted average of the Spot Rate values published by CFBenchmarks during the 60-second intervals immediately preceding the start and end of the time period, respectively. Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

If two or more cryptocurrencies report an identical return (rounded to three decimal places) such that they are tied for the highest
position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."

markets.rules_primary: If the close yield (%) of the 1-minute Pyth candlestick for 5-year U.S. Treasury ending at 1:30 PM EDT on Oct 21, 2026 is at least the opening target yield, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the closing yield of the one-minute Pyth candlestick for 5-year U.S. Treasury ending at 1:30 PM EDT on Oct 21, 2026. The 5-year U.S. Treasury refers to the US5Y, the current on-the-run benchmark of the 5-year U.S. Treasury Note as identified on the Source Agency. Revisions to the Underlying made after Expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 5 decimal places.

Yields are expressed as annualized percentages.

The opening target and settlement yield each use the closing yield of the one-minute Pyth candlestick immediately preceding their observation time. For a 4:45–5:00 PM EDT market, the opening target uses the candle timestamped 4:44 PM, ending at 4:45 PM; settlement uses the candle timestamped 4:59 PM, ending at 5:00 PM. Candlesticks are timestamped by their start time.

If reliable Pyth data is unavailable, the contract’s no-data provisions apply.
